holder-quote: This is how it goes down. The Goblins are still reacting, still turning to see the force of armed warriors on foot racing out of the woods, when Beniar’s [Cavalry], [Riders], and lone [Cataphract] crash into them from the side. They actually take down one of the Hobs in the first clash; a lance straight through the armpit. I wince as I sit in Prost’s house. Nasty.
